integrity_notes: Universal statements follow from explicit invariant and fixed counterexample; exhaustive finite computations only cross-check. Potential alternative formulations in unindexed scheduling literature remain a priority risk.
limitations: Positive construction only for integer r=2 or r=3; fixed five-item obstruction for all integers r>=4. Does not cover arbitrary real ratios, heterogeneous values or three or more agents.
scientific_scope: Two agents with identical positive additive utilities and indivisible goods of sizes 1 and integer r>=2, arriving sequentially, with prefixwise exact MMS and injective itemwise upgrade recourse.
title: The three-to-four size threshold for exact online maximin fairness under itemwise upgrades
